verdict.rationale: Lium is a GPU rental marketplace with a CLI and SDK, so opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question to ask. Nothing in the evidence documents a telemetry opt-out, a do-not-track setting, or any analytics controls. Related privacy features, such as no-email fingerprint signup, no-key public feeds and encrypted volumes, are adjacent and do not count as telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
